Honda CB125F, 2019 (WX69 DFO), the commuter for jobs in town where parking a van or car is a joke. Chain is the stock DID 428 non O-ring. Routine every 300 miles, or after any ride in the rain: warm the chain up with a 5 minute ride, bike up on the paddock stand, spray Muc-Off chain cleaner and scrub with the 3-sided grunge brush, wipe dry with an old T-shirt, then Motul C2 Chain Lube Road spray on the inside of the lower run while turning the back wheel by hand, one full rotation. Leave it 20 minutes before riding so it doesn't fling all over the rim and the tyre. Slack spec is 25 to 35mm at the midpoint of the lower run, measured on the side stand. On 6 June 2025 at 9,870 miles it was 41mm, so loosened the rear axle nut, turned both snail cam adjusters 1 notch, checked the wheel was straight with the marks on the swingarm, axle nut back to 59 Nm. Sprockets 14T front, 42T rear, teeth still look square. Can of C2 is £13.50 at the bike shop on Cheltenham Road and does about 6 months. Oil for the bike is in [[Oil change intervals]]. Fancy doing [[Camping in the Dolomites]] on a bigger bike one day, not this one.
